Name: Dynamic Sam Three Heart Event - Updated
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]An update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9831]Dynamic Sam Three Heart Event[/url], this small mod adds a variant of Sam's 3 heart event that can trigger in Year 2+, which accounts for Kent having returned.

Pebble's original mod is fantastic for anyone who wishes they could still see Sam's 3 heart event past year 1 and makes thoughtful dialogue changes about Sam and Vincent discussing their father's PTSD. However, while it still works in 1.6, it has some code oddities that mean the edited event takes priority, preventing the original year 1 variant from ever being seen, and it changes the event preconditions of the original vanilla event, breaking any other mod that also edits that event.

Since the original author is no longer active in the community and the mod has open permissions, I have updated it to only include the variant event with an added precondition so that if you see the vanilla event, the variant event won't trigger, and converted it to i18n for easy translations. If you enjoy the mod, please download and endorse the original!

Content warning: the mod touches on aspects of war and PTSD as well as some brief mentions of mental health stigma, to the same level of detail as the vanilla event.
[/size]
